prompt:

Each silhouette pixel must have exactly one category color. Nothing outside silhouettes. Preserve all gaps/openings fully transparent.
Input guide is authoritative for geometry and layout; design and icon are appearance references only.
CRITICAL CORRECTION: Preserve the grey guide's silhouettes exactly. The horizontal side-view spearheads are EDGE-ON narrow slivers, NOT broad leaf blades. Do not turn them into face-on blades. The vertical blades retain the guide's exact polygon outline. No stray pixels, fringes or colored halos anywhere. All lower masks have absolutely flat solid category fills with no dark shading or highlights. Precisely trace the guide coverage; do not expand the shaft or blade. Preserve relative positions including bottom row centers.
